{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2020–21 |team=Boise State Broncos |sport=Basketball |image=Boise State Broncos wordmark.svg |image_size=250 |conference=Mountain West Conference |division= |short_conf=MW |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=19–9 |conf_record=14–6 |head_coach=[[Leon Rice]] |hc_year=11th |asst_coach1=[[Mike Burns (basketball)|Mike Burns]] |asst_coach2=[[Tim Duryea]] |asst_coach3=R-Jay Barsh |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[ExtraMile Arena]] |champion= |tourney= [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result= Quarterfinals }} {{2020–21 Mountain West Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Boise State Broncos men's basketball team''' represented [[Boise State University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Broncos, led by 11th-year head coach [[Leon Rice]], played their home games at [[ExtraMile Arena]] as members of the [[Mountain West Conference]]. They finished the season 19-9, 14-6 to finish in 4th place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the Mountain West tournament to [[2020–21 Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball team|Nevada]]. They received an invitation to the NIT where they defeated [[2020–21 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team|SMU]] in the first round before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2020–21 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Boise State Broncos men's basketball team|Broncos]] 20–12, 11–7 in Mountain West play to finish in a tie for fifth place. They defeated [[2019–20 UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball team|UNLV]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament|Mountain West tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2019–20 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]]. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|year=2020|team=Boise State Broncos|teamcolors=y|high_school=yes}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Marcus|last=Shaver Jr.|num=0|pos=G|ft=6|in=2|lbs=185|class=JR|rs=y|home=[[Phoenix, Arizona|Phoenix, AZ]]|high_school=[[Shadow Mountain High School|Shadow Mountain HS]]
